title: DEVAI ratchets a new BUILD-PLAN phase
summary: The Architect drafts a new phase, the Engineer/Inspector execute it batch-by-batch with per-commit gates, the closeout sweep ratifies the phase in BUILD-PLAN.md. The meta-application of the framework to its own development (Article 36).
preconditions: Previous phase is in its closeout state (BUILD-PLAN Status reflects last Phase shipped)
All gates currently green: lint, typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, spec validate-all
No leaked task records or open RGRs

steps.action: Draft a new Phase entry in BUILD-PLAN.md with a per-batch table (typically A through Z); cite a triggering D-N decision or audit
steps.expected_outcome: BUILD-PLAN Status updated with `Current phase: Phase N in progress`; per-batch slots seeded

steps.action: Execute Batch N.A: write the smallest cohesive unit (typically one schema OR one CLI verb OR one set of docs); commit at the end of the batch
steps.expected_outcome: Single commit titled `Batch N.A: <headline>` with a body explaining schema/code/test changes and gate results

steps.action: Inside each batch, add/update tests (unit + integration) for the new surface; ensure existing tests still pass
steps.expected_outcome: pnpm test + pnpm test:integration both green; test count grows commensurately

steps.action: Run per-commit gates: `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run typecheck`, both test suites, `devai spec validate all`, `devai docs links` if docs changed
Iterate batches A → B → C → … as defined in the BUILD-PLAN phase entry; reorder batches if dependency analysis surfaces a better path
steps.expected_outcome: Each batch lands independently; commits read as a coherent story; per-batch revert possible without poisoning downstream batches

steps.action: Execute Batch N.Z (closeout): run the full sweep (`pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration`, `pnpm test:regression`, `devai spec validate all`, `devai docs cli --check`, `devai docs links`), update BUILD-PLAN Status to `Phase N shipped`, write phase-summary CHANGELOG entry
steps.expected_outcome: All sweep checks pass; BUILD-PLAN Status reflects `Phases 0–N complete`; next phase ready to open
alternative_paths: If sweep finds a regression, fix in a Batch N.Z' before declaring Phase N shipped
If a parallel session was running, reconcile conflicts; the per-batch commit discipline minimizes blast radius

postconditions: BUILD-PLAN.md Status section lists Phase N in the shipped table with a `(this)` commit reference
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry under `## Phase N — <title> (YYYY-MM)`
All gates green at HEAD; next Architect-driven phase can open cleanly

acceptance_criteria.statement: DEVAI applies its own discipline to itself across the phase: per-batch commits, per-batch gates, BUILD-PLAN ratification at closeout (Article 36).
Every sense* command emitted during the phase produces a SensorReading conformant to the schema (the substrate-level discipline holds throughout phase execution).
